jobs.text: Drivers see nearby jobs and accept one with a single swipe.

drive.text: The app guides the driver to each customer, turn by turn.

door.text: At the door, the app checks the parcel, records who received it, and saves a photo as proof.

cash.text: Cash on delivery is recorded in the app with one swipe.

onward.text: After each delivery, the app routes the driver to the next customer.

fuel.text: Low on fuel? The app finds the nearest fuel station.

pitstop.text: The app guides the driver to the fuel station.

done.text: Tap Done after refuelling, and the app goes back to the delivery route.

next.text: The route continues to the next customer.

c-home.text: Customers use the app to send parcels and track them.

c-map.text: Choose the pickup location by moving the map.

c-drop.text: Search the area, then add the street and house number for the delivery.

c-who.text: Add the receiver's details and choose a pickup time.

c-fee.text: The app shows the price before booking. Customers can pay in cash on delivery.

c-sent.text: Once booked, the app gives the customer a tracking code.

c-track.text: The payment shows on the order right away, so the rider collects no cash.

m-over.text: The manager dashboard shows today's deliveries at a glance.

m-orders.text: All orders appear in one list, each with its delivery route on the map.

m-jobs.text: The app automatically groups new requests into jobs for drivers.

m-track.text: Live tracking shows every driver's location on the map.

m-lab.text: Route planning builds the day's routes and updates them when orders are added.

m-fleet.text: The vehicles page shows which vehicles are ready for delivery.

m-cod.text: The cash ledger shows how much each driver has collected.

c-pay.text: Customers can pay the fee by scanning an MMQR code with their banking app.
